QUOTE: "Library-internal threads | None. The index finds no spawn site in `library/`." and "Lock wrapper: `mbedtls_threading_mutex_t` with `mbedtls_mutex_init/lock/unlock/free` in `include/mbedtls/threading.h`, backed by pthread functions in `library/threading.c`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that library/ has no thread spawn sites and that library/threading.c supplies the mutex abstraction (wrapper and global mutexes) used by threaded callers.
